cases.translation: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem.
cases.explain: In apposition after the noun 'город', the name takes the nominative case.
The preposition 'с' (from) requires the genitive case.
The preposition 'для' (for) requires the genitive case.
The transitive verb 'услышал' (heard) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: This is God's dwelling with people.
cases.explain: In the possessive construction 'жилище Бога' (God's dwelling), the genitive expresses ownership.

cases.translation: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'отрет' (will wipe) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: The nations will walk in his light.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' with location requires the prepositional case.
The preposition 'из' (of, made from) requires the genitive case.

reading.ru: Я увидел святой город, Новый Иерусалим, спускающийся с небес от Бога, приготовленный как невеста, украшенная для своего мужа.
reading.question: How is the New Jerusalem described when it comes down from heaven?
options: As a bride adorned for her husband
reading.correct: As a bride adorned for her husband
reading.explain: The text explicitly states it was 'приготовленный как невеста, украшенная для своего мужа' (prepared like a bride adorned for her husband).

reading.ru: Это жилище Бога с людьми. Здесь он будет жить с ними, и они будут его народом.
reading.question: What is God's dwelling, according to the passage?
options: His presence with people, who will be His people
reading.correct: His presence with people, who will be His people
reading.explain: The text states 'Это жилище Бога с людьми' and 'он будет жить с ними, и они будут его народом' (This is God's dwelling with people; He will live with them and they will be His people).

reading.ru: Он отрет с их глаз каждую слезу. Больше не будет ни смерти, ни скорби, ни вопля, ни боли, потому что прежнее ушло.
reading.question: What will happen to suffering and death in the New Jerusalem?
options: They will be reduced but still present
They will be transformed into joy
They will be kept outside the city
reading.explain: The passage explicitly states that God 'отрет с их глаз каждую слезу' and 'Больше не будет ни смерти, ни скорби, ни вопля, ни боли' (will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more death, sorrow, crying, or pain).

reading.ru: У города большая и высокая стена, и двенадцать ворот, а у ворот двенадцать ангелов.
reading.question: How many gates does the city have, and what guards them?
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'двенадцать ворот, а у ворот двенадцать ангелов' (twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels).

reading.ru: На воротах написаны имена двенадцати родов Израиля. Трое ворот с востока, трое с севера, трое с юга и трое с запада.
reading.question: What names are written on the gates of the city?
options: The names of the twelve apostles
The names of the twelve tribes of Israel
reading.correct: The names of the twelve tribes of Israel
reading.explain: The passage states 'На воротах написаны имена двенадцати родов Израиля' (The names of the twelve tribes of Israel are written on the gates).

reading.ru: Храма в городе я не видел, потому что его храм — это сам Господь Бог Вседержитель и Ягненок.
reading.question: Why is there no temple in the New Jerusalem?
options: It was destroyed in the siege
The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb themselves are its temple
reading.correct: The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb themselves are its temple
reading.explain: The text explains 'его храм — это сам Господь Бог Вседержитель и Ягненок' (its temple is the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb themselves).
